scope: Fortnite competitive registration, qualification-route, participant-outcome and final reminder intelligence for EU/France

principles.policy_state_separation: This engine defines rules; persistent observed state remains in ledgers. Changing policy never rewrites historical facts.
principles.route_aware: Qualification is modeled as one or more routes/attempts toward a target; losing one route never implies elimination if another official route remains.
principles.conditional_notices: Participant reminders are armed only when their evidence-backed conditions are true at execution time.
principles.result_finality: Provisional standings and final official qualification results are distinct; provisional data cannot permanently eliminate a participant.
principles.no_absence_inference: Missing pages, missing names or one failed crawl never prove non-qualification.
principles.no_backfill: When a condition becomes true late, only future notices are armed; past reminders are never recreated.
principles.global_vs_participant: Global event reminders and participant-specific play/registration reminders are independent.

rules: FAILED_ROUTE is path-scoped, never event-scoped elimination by itself.
A participant is ELIMINATED_EVENT only when every officially available route to the tracked target is closed/failed/cancelled and the result evidence is final enough.
LCQ remains active independently of a failed primary qualifier when officially available.
INVITE/DIRECT_FINAL routes can skip registration and qualifiers only with official evidence.
Unknown future routes are never invented merely because a circuit historically had an LCQ.
RESULT_PROVISIONAL can follow qualifier completion when standings are published but not yet sufficiently final to resolve advancement.
QUALIFICATION_PENDING means the play phase is over but advancement cannot yet be safely determined.
QUALIFICATION_RESOLVED requires official final/explicit advancement evidence or mathematically complete final standings plus a verified qualification rule.
An official correction after resolution increments lifecycle_version and preserves superseded result history.
QUALIFIED means the participant is confirmed into the referenced target, not merely advanced to another qualifier round.
ADVANCED is used for progression to a non-final downstream phase.
ELIMINATED_PATH means one qualification route ended unsuccessfully but another route may remain.
ELIMINATED_EVENT means no official route remains to the tracked target and strong final evidence supports non-qualification.
Provisional standings may set PENDING/ACTIVE but never irreversible ELIMINATED_EVENT.
Roster outcomes are scoped to the exact official roster; do not transfer a duo outcome to a different duo containing one same player.
DORMANT holds a known future reminder whose participant condition is not yet true.
ARMED means all conditions are currently satisfied and a future trigger can be scheduled.
SUPPRESSED_CONDITION is reversible while the trigger remains future and conditions may become true again.
INVALIDATED is permanent for the referenced version/timing and requires a new version to re-arm.
SENT never sends again for the same dedupe key.

suppress_if: participant already registered for this route

rules: Each officially distinct qualifier opportunity is a separate attempt under a route or a separate route when it feeds differently.
Failing attempt 1 does not suppress attempt 2 if attempt 2 is officially still available.
LAST_QUALIFIER_AT for a target is the latest still-valid official session among all active routes feeding that target.
Once QUALIFIED_TARGET is confirmed, remaining play reminders for alternative qualification routes are suppressed, not deleted.

result_and_correction_policy.provisional: Provisional standings can update rank/points and set WAIT_RESULT/PENDING but cannot permanently eliminate or qualify unless the source explicitly marks advancement as final.
result_and_correction_policy.final: Final official standings plus a verified advancement rule can derive QUALIFIED/ELIMINATED_PATH/ELIMINATED_EVENT.
result_and_correction_policy.appeal_or_admin_pending: If Epic/organizer indicates review, adjudication or unresolved tiebreak, keep result_finality PROVISIONAL and participant state PENDING.
result_and_correction_policy.correction: A later official correction creates a new outcome with supersedes_outcome_id; old reminders are invalidated and future reminders recalculated.
result_and_correction_policy.no_delete: Never delete superseded outcomes or lifecycle transitions.

rules: Return one primary next_action and optional secondary_actions.
A deadline already missed is never returned as next_action.
If participant is QUALIFIED, alternative qualifier actions disappear and the final becomes next_action when scheduled.
If one route failed but LCQ remains official, next_action may become PLAY_LCQ rather than ELIMINATED_EVENT.
If qualifier ended and result is not final, next_action is WAIT_RESULT.

quiet_hours.rule: Defer only when the delayed notice remains actionable.

dedupe.notice_key: competition_id + route_id-or-phase_id + session_id-or-null + participant_id-or-global + type + trigger_at + lifecycle_version + route_version
dedupe.outcome_key: participant_id + competition_id + phase_id + route_id-or-null + state + target_id-or-null + result_fingerprint
dedupe.correction: Corrected outcomes use a new fingerprint and supersedes_outcome_id; the old key remains historical.

invalidation.registration_extended: Invalidate future notices tied to the old closes_at; increment route/lifecycle version and recalculate.
invalidation.reschedule: Keep IDs, invalidate notices tied to old timing and recalculate against the new official timing.
invalidation.route_failed: Suppress only notices for that route unless no other route remains.
invalidation.qualified_elsewhere: Suppress unused alternative qualifier/LCQ play notices; retain global watch/attend notices.
invalidation.eliminated_event: Invalidate participant PLAY/REGISTER/CHECK_IN downstream notices, preserve global WATCH/ATTEND.
invalidation.postponed: Invalidate timing-dependent notices until a new official time is known.
invalidation.cancelled: Invalidate all future notices in scope.

rules: Every route competition_id/phase_id/session_id resolves to canonical competitive ledger objects.
Every strong participant outcome has admissible official evidence and a finality compatible with the state.
ELIMINATED_EVENT is invalid while an official active route to the same target remains.
QUALIFIED requires a target_id unless the official result itself names the target implicitly and the graph resolves it uniquely.
No notice trigger may be created in the past.
No conditional participant notice may be ARMED without a tracked participant entry.
